frontmatter.description: Triggered when the user asks to write WordPress articles compatible with Rank Math SEO. Produces Gutenberg block-paste-ready HTML with HowTo/FAQ blocks, FK density 1.0-1.5%, 12 H2 structure.

loaderBehaviour: Windsurf reads .windsurf/rules/*.md as Cascade Rules. Project scope only — there is no user-global rules folder. References must be embedded inline; the installer concatenates the most-needed reference files into the rule body.
